summary.text: Brett Windrow is the Democratic candidate for the Tennessee House of Representatives, District 13, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Robert Stevens (R).
An attorney, he says he is running to improve infrastructure and public schools and to reduce housing and living costs.

paragraphs.text: Brett Windrow earned a bachelor's degree from Tennessee Technological University in 2017 and a law degree from Belmont University College of Law in 2020.
His career experience includes working as an attorney, and in a Ballotpedia survey he described himself as an attorney with years of legislative experience.
Windrow advanced from the August 6, 2026 Democratic primary unopposed.

In the survey, he listed his priorities as supporting local governments and public transit to ease traffic on I-24, repealing the school voucher program and redirecting that money to public schools, and encouraging more housing construction and changing the tax structure to benefit working people.
He also named health care, worker protections and tort law among the policy areas he cares about.
